details:
Legacy world IDs can soft-lock clients via portals (unrecoverable black screen)

Description:

Very old VRChat worlds using legacy world IDs such as:

o_oKEJ2RpOP1

can still exist and be referenced by VRChat, but attempting to load them in the current client can fail during instance creation.

Example world:

https://vrchat.com/home/world/o_oKEJ2RpOP1/info

This is a legitimate legacy world from around 2016 using the older VRChat world ID format.

When attempting to enter the world, the client tries to create an instance using the legacy world ID and the API rejects it:

2026.08.08 18:44:51 Error - [API] [2865, 400, Post, -1 https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/instances] Abandoning request, because - worldId must be an ID˸ 'o_oKEJ2RpOP1'

2026.08.08 18:44:51 Debug - [API] Failed loading world instance : worldId must be an ID˸ 'o_oKEJ2RpOP1'

2026.08.08 18:44:51 Error - Failed creating world instance : worldId must be an ID˸ 'o_oKEJ2RpOP1'

Immediately afterward, the client attempts:

2026.08.08 18:44:51 Debug - [API] [2866] Sending Get request to https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/instances/

2026.08.08 18:44:51 Error - [API] [2866, 403, Get, 2] Request Finished with Error!

{"error":{"message":""Invalid Admin Credentials"","status_code":403}}

After this happens, the client remains on a completely black screen indefinitely and does not recover. The only way I have found to recover is to completely restart VRChat.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Launch VRChat.

2. Attempt to enter the legacy world o_oKEJ2RpOP1.

3. VRChat begins the world transition.

4. The screen becomes completely black.

5. The instance API rejects the legacy world ID.

6. The client remains stuck on the black screen until VRChat is restarted.

Expected behavior:

Legacy worlds that still exist in VRChat's database should either continue to load, or VRChat should gracefully reject the transition and return the player to their previous instance or home.

A failed instance creation request should not leave the client in an unrecoverable loading state.

Portal / abuse impact:

Portals to affected legacy worlds can still be dropped in VRChat.

Because entering one of these portals can trigger the same unrecoverable black-screen state, another player could potentially use a portal to an affected legacy world to intentionally force other players into this broken world transition.

I would not classify this as a denial-of-service issue because it does not appear to involve resource exhaustion or overwhelming the client. Instead, it appears to be an unhandled error or exception during the world transition / instance creation process that leaves the client soft-locked.

The VRChat process itself remains running, but the player cannot recover from the black screen without restarting the client.

Possible underlying issues:

1. The current /api/1/instances endpoint rejects legitimate legacy world IDs such as o_oKEJ2RpOP1.

2. The client does not properly handle or recover from the failed instance creation/world transition.

3. Portals can still direct other players into affected legacy worlds, allowing this broken state to be triggered unintentionally or intentionally.

Suggested fixes:

- Support legacy world IDs in the instance API, or internally map them to a modern/canonical world identifier.

- Prevent portals from targeting worlds that cannot successfully create or load instances.

- If instance creation fails, abort the world transition and return the player to their previous instance or home.

- Add proper error/exception handling so a failed instance request cannot leave the client permanently stuck on a black screen.
title: Legacy World IDs, and unhandled exceptions
